style: Vertical 9:16 cinematic frame, photoreal, rich film grain, deep shadows. Palette: void black, deep navy, chalk white, eclipse gold, event cyan, exotic violet accents. No text, no letters, no logos, no human faces.

ep2.what: Hook: the Eclipse Gate (ring of 24 floating obsidian segments with a gold rim around a lensing sphere of stars) violently collapses inward, the segments crashing to the center
Lola's orb (glowing blue sphere, white waveform across its center, three gold orbital rings) floats in a dark observatory beside an old chalkboard covered in curved spacetime sketches
Callback to Ep 1: a glowing cyan wireframe of an Einstein-Rosen bridge (two funnels joined at a narrow neck) drawn over a sepia chalkboard, chalk dust in the light
Diagram: tunnel with a narrow middle, label THROAT
1962 physics office at night: a large chalkboard with spacetime diagrams, a desk lamp, slide rule, stacked papers and a typewriter, sepia tones, no people
Inside view of a wormhole throat made of rippling spacetime: it opens wide, then pinches shut violently while a beam of light racing through is cut off before it reaches the far side
A small silver space probe drifts into a narrowing tunnel of warped spacetime and is squeezed and crushed as the walls close
A glowing cyan grid of spacetime sinks into a deep well around a dense planet; streams of starlight and dust spiral inward, everything pulled toward the center
Diagram: arrows pulling inward (gravity) vs arrows pushing outward (negative energy)
A shimmering violet substance of light swirls into a spacetime grid and pushes the grid outward, bulging it open, exotic and otherworldly
1988 university office at night: a desk with hand-drawn diagrams of a wormhole held open, a chalkboard full of equations, a cup of coffee, an early desktop computer glowing, no people
A large radio telescope dish under a starry night sky, a single lit window in the control building, a stack of typed manuscript pages on a windowsill in the foreground
A stable traversable wormhole held open by a glowing violet ring of exotic matter; the camera flies smoothly through the throat toward a different starfield on the far side
The Eclipse Gate stands open and perfectly steady on a frozen plain at dusk, its event surface rippling calmly, sci-fi style
Lola's orb (glowing blue sphere, white waveform, three gold rings) hovers in darkness facing a faint swirling cloud of violet negative energy, contemplative
Teaser: two polished parallel metal plates float very close together in a dark vacuum chamber, a faint violet glow trembling in the narrow gap between them

ep3.what: Hook: two polished parallel metal plates in a dark vacuum, a strange violet glow flickering in the narrow gap between them, sparks of light popping in and out
Lola's orb (glowing blue sphere, white waveform across its center, three gold orbital rings) floats in a dark laboratory beside a vacuum chamber with a small window
Reuse Ep 2 shot E2S13 (wormhole held open by violet ring)
Empty black space slowly revealed to be fizzing: countless tiny sparks and ripples of light flickering in and out of existence, quantum foam, macro
Extreme macro of pairs of tiny glowing particles appearing and vanishing in darkness, faint cyan and violet waves rippling between them
1948 industrial physics laboratory, sepia: a workbench with brass instruments, a notebook of handwritten equations, a desk lamp, glass vacuum tubes, no people
Two polished parallel metal plates slowly moving closer together inside a glass vacuum chamber, lit by cold cyan light
Diagram: waves between plates (only fitting waves) vs outside (all waves)
Diagram: energy meter, empty space = 0, between plates below zero, NEGATIVE ENERGY
Glowing ripples of energy press in from all sides onto two parallel metal plates and squeeze them together, the gap between them dark
1997 physics lab: a torsion pendulum apparatus inside a vacuum enclosure, a small gold-coated lens near a flat plate, cables and an oscilloscope glowing green, no people
Microscopic view: a tiny polished sphere on a cantilever slowly approaches a flat gold surface, a faint violet glow appearing in the gap, scientific macro
Microscope view: a single rod-shaped bacterium drifts beside two metal plates whose gap is even narrower than the bacterium, sense of tiny scale
Scale shot in space: the giant planet Jupiter looms in the background while a tiny glowing wormhole only one meter wide hovers in the foreground beside a spacesuited figure seen from behind
A large lever on a futuristic control console is pulled and the Eclipse Gate in the window behind powers up instantly in a flash of gold light, sci-fi style
Lola's orb (glowing blue sphere, white waveform, three gold rings) hovers above two tiny glowing metal plates, looking at the faint violet spark between them, contemplative
